families.referenceCue: Broad luminous sky graded from pale warm horizon to soft cerulean-ultramarine upper sky with soft cloud transitions.
Central Gothic gable peak and twin chimneys in warm sunlit yellow-ochre and raw-sienna ashlar masonry against the sky.
Left stepped gable, chimneys, and slate roof ridge in warm ochre-sienna stone with cool-violet cast shadow planes.
Left sunlit masonry facade with pointed Gothic windows and continuous warm stone courses.
Main central sunlit gable wall with tall traceried Gothic window, rose roundel, and warm continuous stone courses.
Right wing gable and turret in warm sunlit stone with cool shadow under the eaves.
Shaded right porch and deep Gothic archway recess in cool ultramarine-sienna shadow.
Deep arched portal recess between left and central bays with crisp dark architectural aperture.
Warm olive-green and burnt-sienna foliage mass framing the left edge of the chapel.
Rounded sunlit sap-green and ochre shrub mass at the base of the central gable wall.
Foliage mass on the right margin in warm sap-green, ochre, and cool lower shadow.
Sunlit foreground lawn and path in pale yellow-green and warm ochre-rose washes.
Horizontal cool violet-umber cast shadow bands across the lower foreground path and lawn.
Small foreground figures and bench accents with reserved light touches and crisp dark notes.

styleSelection.reason: Trumbull architectural watercolor: continuous warm ochre-sienna stone washes built light-to-dark over crisp structural ink, connected violet-ultramarine shadows, and dark window recesses.
